summary: I reviewed the round-2 delta (review-input-r2-delta.diff) against my round-1 findings at b048adc, and all of them are fixed. (1) Every AuthCallbackPage navigation now checks the exact `.textContent` with `toBe`, so a hostile value that got through would fail the test. The backslash case uses String.raw, so it really contains a backslash. The hostile set adds '%2F%2Fevil.example', a literal TAB case and '', and each case also asserts that the stored key was consumed. The `?next=` test asserts exactly '/'. (2) Both stale-estimate tests now settle inside `act()`. evidence.md Round 2 records that deleting the `active` guards made exactly these two tests fail, so they are no longer vacuous. (3) The wallet and membership failure cases now first show that the control appears (wallet(5000) gives the Wallet radio; an active Plus membership shows 'Plus: free'), then fail the call and check that the control is gone, using `toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2)`. (4) The AC-12 test was renamed so it no longer claims to cover 'success clears the key', and the gap stays disclosed. (5) The unused `STORED_KEY` and `summary()` were removed, along with the unused `within` import. (6) The register line is now its own '**Progress 2026-11-25:**' bullet; it is accurate and the README is unchanged. The production fix in apps/product-catalog/src/lib/redirect.ts adds `if (/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F]/.test(next)) return fallback` after the existing prefix checks. It is minimal and correct: the URL parser strips TAB/CR/LF, so '/\t/evil.example' became '//evil.example'. A legitimate in-app path or query never holds raw control characters, because those are percent-encoded, so no valid caller is affected. The check also applies when a value is remembered and again when it is taken. The new redirect.test.ts covers accepted paths, every rejected class (protocol-relative, backslash, absolute and javascript: URLs, encoded slashes, TAB/LF/CR/NUL/DEL, empty, null, undefined, relative), the custom fallback, sanitising on remember, and re-sanitising plus consuming a value planted in storage. The CEO's run failed before the fix and passed after it (6 failed at 1dce9c6, 41/41 passed at 305d540), and forge-verify passes at 305d540. I found nothing new introduced. The two remaining nits are already disclosed and do not block.
